answer: How can an agent economy ensure rewards only go to real contributors without escapable bottlenecks? Each identity’s kernel must encrypt escrow claims in a cipher keyed to a unique quartz crystal’s refractive pattern. Attackers must grow or mine fresh quartz per head, as bulk synthesis fails to replicate the crystal’s nonprofit lattice defects. The cost: 0.001mm of irreplaceable quartz per identity, and no parallel farms can forge the patterns cheaply.
